key_reasoning.reason: New shared UserContext model added to rest_api/security/user.py and consumed across two independent tool-invocation subsystems: MCP (service/mcp/client.py, service/mcp/models.py MCPExecutionContext + MCPToolInvocationRequest) and DSP provider (service/provider/provider_tool_factory.py). 4 source components across the security-model, service, and external-egress layers.

PII (name/email/picture) is forwarded on a new external wire path to MCP-Connect and DSP provider tools, plus diagnostic logging of user context. Masking is hand-rolled (_mask_value, _mask_email, UserContext.masked_for_logging) with no pre-existing reusable util. Hard deploy-ordering dependency: cannot merge before MCP-Connect EPMCDME-14847 is fully rolled out across all bridge buckets, no feature flag, and the ticket was reopened after prior regression EPMCDME-13546. mr-notes.md requests a /sanity regression pass.
